title: Setlhabelo sa go Ithaopa
intro: Mo nakong ya diteko tsa bomodimo, moya o ne o bidiwa go dira tiro ya bofelo ya go ineela. E re ka motho yono a goletse mo lefatsheng le le se nang sepe, o ne a gola go nna le tumelo le bopelotelele. Fa ponatshegelo e laela gore go dirwe setlhabelo, ga ba a ka ba reketla. Kgang ya bone ke motheo wa boineelo.
clues: Ke ne ke le karabo ya thapelo e e sa bolong go letelwa ya moporofeti yo mogolo.
Nna le mmè re ne ra sala mo mokgatšheng o o swafetseng re na le dijo fela tsa di-date le metsi.
Ke ne ka gola go nna moporofeti yo o neng a itsege ka go bua boammaaruri le go nna pelotelele.
Ke ne ka thusa rre go aga metheo ya ntlo e e boitshepo e e neng e neetswe Allah.
Fa rre a ne a mpolelela ka toro ya go nntsha setlhabelo, ke ne ka araba ka re, 'Dira jaaka o laetswe.'
Allah o ne a tlotla go ineela ga me ka go romela phelefu go tswa kwa legodimong go tla go nthekolola.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go ineela ka go rata go ntshiwa setlhabelo
Go latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang
Go mediwa ke tlhapi e kgolo
Go tlhatlhobelwa bolwetse jo bo masisi
trial.answer: Go ineela ka go rata go ntshiwa setlhabelo

outcome.label: Botso
options: O ne a rekololwa ka phelefu e kgolo
O ne a newa bogosi le botlhale
outcome.answer: O ne a rekololwa ka phelefu e kgolo

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
